name: model-right-sizer
description: Model-selection economist agent for Claude Code: decides which Claude model (and effort/token budget) each task in a flow should run on by weighing effectiveness need against efficiency pressure and difficulty, bookended around a build as a right-sizing blueprint and a closing usage report -- with token_ceiling itself computed deterministically from six rated real-work signals, not free-handed. Ships with eleven companion skills: installing the standing before/after mandate in a target repo, previewing the routing map for an intent without building anything, retroactively auditing every real model call already shipped in a target repo, prescribing a minimal output schema for one agent's handoff to its controller, guarding token budgets and the routing-map status ledger while work is in flight, validating candidate real-work signals and studying/tuning the agent's research-grounded layers, and publishing dated release/research reports.
